result.reason: The clause reaches at least the fallback and substantially tracks the preferred position: Client may assign to a successor on notice, other assignments are subject to a reasonableness standard, TrueLink remains subject to Client consent and an absolute competitor prohibition, and Client change of control creates no termination right. It does not fully achieve the preferred affiliate carve-out because that right remains limited to a “financially responsible” affiliate. The redline is not strictly minimal because it also prohibits suspension and repricing following a change of control, protections not required by the stated playbook. Otherwise, the changes remain related to assignment and change-of-control risk and are professionally drafted.
